pages.title: Direct audio URLs
pages.text: Remote streams require server permission. Use a direct public HTTP(S) MP3/WAV URL, not a video page. Private and loopback addresses are blocked.

pages.title: Playing a stream
pages.text: Add Stream in Library offers Play, Queue and playlist destinations. URLs can be up to 256 characters. Each listening client connects to the URL; streams are separate from uploaded recordings.

pages.title: Stream limits
pages.text: Unknown-duration streams cannot seek or serve as announcements. Their comparator output is 7 while playing.
